messages:
lara: Intake for halcyon-6.5b — external weights here: https://git.example.com/halcyon/weights. Short: 6.5B, mixed web/book, LICENSE.md has non-commercial clause. Want to evaluate for Hosted API + Dedicated. Need legal + quant check. :eyes:

samir: can you paste the exact license language? NC usually blocks hosted offerings.

lara: snippet from LICENSE.md: "Model weights are licensed for research and non-commercial use only. Commercial use requires separate agreement with the model maintainer." Also says "no redistribution of weights".

samir: yeah that's an NC + redistribution restriction. We can't add to hosted catalog unless we get a commercial license. Dedicated/private might be OK if customer holds license or we do a private deploy with customer-provided keys. Also flagging export-control risk (some corp training data references).

jess: did a quick quant sweep (local): fp16 -> q4_0 shows Perplexity +1.2x and some hallucination on long-context (>2048). Examples attached in eval bundle. FWIW q8_0 looks promising but we need kernel support for the custom layer norm.

oliver: infra note: halcyon uses a fused-custom LayerNormV2 op. Our q4 kernels throw shape errors. Options: implement kernel fallback (2-3w) or force fp16 runtime with lower throughput.

lara: action items: (1) @samir confirm commercial licensing path or dual-license; (2) @jess run full eval-suite + create failure set; (3) @oliver estimate infra patch work and perf delta; (4) I'll file intake ticket and tag priority. Target: decision by EOD Fri.

samir: pinging upstream maintainer now; will request commercial/enterprise license terms and data provenance docs. Also checking whether weights redistribution clause can be relaxed for vendor-hosting.

ci-bot: Created issue #1324: "halcyon-6.5b licensing & infra intake" — assigned to @samir, @oliver, @jess.

lara: uploaded eval artifacts: gs://redwood-evals/halcyon-6p5b/2026-03-19.tar.gz — contains prompt regressions, metrics, and diffs.

jess: quick numbers: roleplay-bench QA dropped from 0.78 -> 0.69 under q4_0 on prompt window 3k. With q8_0 or int8+fp16-mixed we might recover to ~0.75. If legal blocks hosting, deprioritize.

samir: upstream replied: maintainer open to dual-license (research-only + commercial enterprise), cost TBD; needs legal ops to draft MSA. I'll loop legal ops and procurement.

oliver: rough estimate: kernel patch ~3 dev-weeks; temporary fp16 on dedicated increases serving cost ~2x relative to quantized. If procurement OK with license cost + infra, we can onboard.

lara: noted. Marking PRIORITY-MED and adding to model-board. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
